lines: Commits: f9d0220b (cherry-picked V1 contracts 9e24efe9, drops out on rebase); 7faa3cc0 feat(portfolio): add the client Breakdown view to Portfolio; 5ca65326 and ae20af72 'amend! feat(portfolio): ...' (git --fixup=amend; the last one's message, ae20af72, becomes the final message on autosquash); a066f00d 'fixup! feat(portfolio): ...' (code only, message unchanged).

a066f00d: V1's 0c20bd19 renames oneTime[].allocationId to entryId. My only use was the React key, now `${effectiveDate}:${index}` after sorting (blocks hold no state). I typechecked locally against 0c20bd19's contract file (then restored it): it compiles with both the cherry-picked and the renamed contract, so the rebase onto V1 needs no change here.

Layout (maintainer's one-row call): under 'Your investments', one row. Left: Positions | Breakdown from the existing ui Tabs/TabPanel (tablist/tab, aria-selected, aria-controls, arrow keys), made compact from the lane recipe (text-xs, px-3) without touching shared ui. Right: quiet borderless text links to Value updates and SIP plans, same destinations and showsSipPlans rule.

Labels: below 400 px 'Updates' and 'SIPs'; from 400 px 'Value updates' and 'SIP plans'. aria-label is always 'Value updates' / 'SIP plans'. For review: 'SIPs' is not a substring of 'SIP plans' (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name); 'Updates' is.

Measured (RUNTIME, mock preview): one line (same top), 44 px, nothing cut, scrollWidth = width. 360 with SIPs: Positions 20-96, Breakdown 100-188, Updates 234-302, SIPs 302-344; 360 no SIPs: Updates 277-344; 412 with SIPs: Value updates 222-325, SIP plans 325-397; 412 no SIPs: Value updates 294-397; 1440: 44 px.
?view: Positions has no param, Breakdown sets ?view=breakdown, replace; Back from a fund returns to Breakdown; ?view=other shows Positions. L2: reversed one-time growth and return in the muted tone.

Screenshots in .temp/worktrees/v-client-breakdown/.temp/v-client-breakdown/shots/: {360,412}-row-{positions,breakdown}-{sips,nosips}.png, 1440-row-breakdown-sips.png, crop-*.png (the row only). Older *-tab-* and toggle shots are superseded.

Commits: 7faa3cc0 feat(portfolio): add the client Breakdown view to Portfolio, on top of the cherry-picked V1 contracts commit f9d0220b (= 9e24efe9). The cherry-pick drops out when the coordinator rebases onto main after V1 lands.

Wiring: done. breakdownQueries.ts calls getClientInvestmentBreakdown; key qk.client.investmentBreakdown() = ['client','investment-breakdown'], also added to CLIENT_MONEY_PREFIXES so useInvalidateMoney refreshes it. Nothing left to wire on the client side; it only needs V1's backend route on main.
Files: features/portfolio/BreakdownView.tsx, breakdownQueries.ts, PortfolioViewControl.tsx (new); PortfolioScreen.tsx, portfolio.recipe.ts; api/queryKeys.ts.

View control: Value updates and SIP plans stay links to their screens; Breakdown is a toggle button (aria-pressed) that swaps the Positions list for the breakdown, kept in ?view=breakdown with replace (so Back from a fund returns to it, and history does not grow). 3-column equal grid on phones, a row from sm up. SIP plans still hides when the client has no SIP plans (2 columns then). No route added (routing manifests outside the lane).

Per fund: active SIP, Ended SIP, one-time newest first, then 'Other adjustments'. Client sorts too (defensive; server already orders). Amounts with paise (MoneyValue showDecimals), returns via formatBasisPoints, XIRR null shows 'Available after 30 days'. Labels: Invested, Current value, Growth, Return, 'Annualised return (XIRR)', 'X of Y months paid', Reversed badge. Preparing: 'Your breakdown is being prepared by BeOnEdge.' Failed read: AsyncBoundary error state with Try again; market-risk footnote unchanged below.
Rule 11: no response shape changed; the breakdown endpoint is new, so released apps never call it. Rule 10: no test; the switch holds display state only.

Links: Value updates and SIP plans are ButtonLinks (secondary, sm) in their own row above the tabs, same destinations and same showsSipPlans rule; this matches the Activity screen (Receipts link row, then tabs).
